note: Portfolio-management estimates for ARIS4C 000. Progress is not a scientific result; 100 means the current repository-level final output contract is satisfied. Activity is a live execution state with exactly four values: finish, active, wait, or block. Finish means the current final/output contract is complete. Active means meaningful research work is running now or has produced a recent substantive paper-folder update. Wait means the next meaningful step is executable but is not currently being advanced. Block means meaningful progress depends on an external/human/independent-review/data-transfer/permission or similar dependency. Metadata-only, README, Pages, and handoff-sync commits do not make a project Active.

005.stage: Confirmatory adjudication still gated - evidence layer measured, database-coverage re-probe in flight
005.evidence: 10,000-work evidence census: 62.4% have an OpenAlex abstract, 24.4% an OA PDF, and 3,506 (35.1%) have neither; the frozen batch packets themselves carry no title, abstract or full text at all, so no AI adjudicator can be shown article text under the current packet schema. Missingness is time- and domain-graded (abstract coverage 51.6% in 2000-2009 vs 78.5% in 2025+; Physical Sciences lowest at 58.6%), which is the band the paper's hidden-burden and Sleeping-Beauty quantities concentrate in. Alternate researcher-facing sources are being measured on all 3,506 gap works (1,627 DOI-bearing, 1,879 title-only). An first pass reported Europe PMC at 0.0%; that number is retracted - the probe was sending Europe PMC the https://doi.org/ URL form, which silently returns zero hits, while Crossref and Unpaywall accept it. With the bare DOI, 17 of 25 sampled biomedicine gap works resolve in Europe PMC. The corrected full-sample probe is still running, so no per-source coverage rate from it is quotable yet.
005.next_gate: Finish the corrected alt-database probe, publish per-source coverage with a verified-match rule, then decide among: abstract-retrieval packets plus recorded EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE abstentions, a full-text pipeline, or a narrowed post-2015/OA subframe; only then run the dual-AI adjudication, arbitration and calibration.
005.blocker: Not an idle AI surface. 35.1% of the probability sample has no machine-readable text and the packets retrieve none. Free-keyed sources can partially close it - Europe PMC for biomedicine looks real and Crossref's DOI resolution is high - but the corrected yield is not yet measured, and title-only matching against Crossref's fuzzy bibliographic search cannot be trusted without an exact-title gate. Decide the evidence policy on the corrected numbers before any adjudication run.

scheduling.capacity_rule: No fixed hard cap. Expand or contract Active WIP according to the current model/agent/tool capacity, genuine parallelism, paper-level context isolation, checkpoint discipline, and truthful live-state tracking; exceeding 3 is allowed when those conditions remain strong.
scheduling.selection_rule: continue active first; when additional genuine execution capacity is available, choose the highest-progress wait paper; exclude block and finish unless explicitly overridden
scheduling.checkpoint_rule: commit each bounded substantive work unit and sync handoff before intentionally switching papers
